searchText: what's going on with Hoodi? seems fine to me? https://dora.hoodi.ethpandaops.io/ likely an explorer issue ok, but that's also a dora they're both doras connected to different backend nodes though so different datasource That's a rare edge case. Dora calculated the proposer duties wrong, and the last state request failed or timed out, so it didn't have the proposer lookahead from state.. It should resolve on it's own after the epoch completed as the state is re-fetched at the end of the epoch. The logic will change for gloas anyway as I need to load a full state at the beginning of each epoch to get proper PTC duties
